name: uk-events-finder
title: UK Events Finder: Skiddle + Eventbrite + DICE (What's On API)
description: What's on in any UK city from Skiddle, Eventbrite and DICE in one de-duplicated list: gigs, club nights, comedy, theatre, food, family and business events. Date, venue, postcode, GPS, price, line-up, ticket link. $1 per 1,000 events.
